release_name: A shared Mass link opened the wrong Mass
notes: Promotes beta v27.6.18 and v27.6.19. Sharing a Mass produces a link ending in #row=<id>. Opened cold that worked, but tapping one while the app was ALREADY open did nothing: navigating to a different fragment does not reload the page, and the restore handler was bound to popstate alone, which fires for back and forward but not for a new fragment. Whichever Mass was already on screen stayed there and the shared one never opened, so somebody sent a link to a Tuesday 07:00 Mass could sit looking at a Sunday 06:30 Mass at a different church with no sign the link had failed. The handler is now bound to hashchange as well and reconciles the open sheet with the hash, so a link carrying no Mass closes a stale one. Also verified with no defect found: saved churches persist, survive a reload and render correctly, and no site_uid changed in any release, so no saved church was lost. No data change: 426 rows, 121 sites.
